name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.29: fridge lighting policy in config, plus a set_led command. Backend half only - the dashboard panel and the removal of the legacy 0-10 ledBrightness control land together in the next build so there is never a window with neither. Config's fridge block now carries led: mode off/on/schedule, brightness 0-100, an optional night window with its own level, and a wake block. brightness is 0-100 everywhere operator-facing; the board's own scale is the SDK's grade, whose range is not in the signature, so the app maps it and the operator scale is not hostage to it. The night window's timezone is stated explicitly and never inferred from the machine. night.from > night.to means the window WRAPS MIDNIGHT, which the naive now>=from && now<=to test gets wrong for every minute of it - dealInSchedule in storage.js already handles this and is the thing to copy. night.requiresClockProof is always sent true and is not operator-settable: these boards come back from a power cut with the clock badly wrong (2000-01-01 and 2026-12-26 both seen this month) and a wrong clock fails TLS silently, so the app must hold the day level until one successful authenticated poll has proved the clock. Too bright at 3am is a nuisance; dark at midday is lost sales. wake is triggered on door unlock - the app drives the lock, it is earlier than door-open, and screen-touch would fire on idle curiosity all evening - and ends at the settle after door close, no sooner than holdSeconds. The wake applies even when mode is off: off means dark when nobody is here, not dark for a paying customer. set_led takes brightness 0-100 (0 is off) for instant effect while config stays the durable truth, mirroring set_aisle_enabled over disabledAisles. Cumulative over v6.28.2.
